brand_detail.riferimenti_editoriali:
Editorial references


---

**JUSTIFICATION (for internal review only):**

This UK-GB rendering maintains the archival, library-like quality implied by "riferimenti editoriali" while adopting the restrained, editorial register expected in British design editorial contexts. "References" carries both scholarly and editorial weight—evoking footnotes, citations, and catalogued materials—without the transactional coldness of "links" or the platform-speak of "resources." The phrase functions as a section label in an editorial cockpit where studio owners curate their atlas of brands and materials, mirroring the measured tone of publications like *The World of Interiors*.
